**BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn** is a specialized psychiatric department focusing on toddler and early childhood psychiatry. It operates within [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] and is organizationally part of [[aarhus-universitetshospital-psykiatrien|Aarhus Universitetshospital, Psykiatrien]] [^src5] [^src6]. The clinic plays a dominant role in the region's pediatric psychiatric data; for certain quality indicators, it reports identical figures to the entirety of Region Midtjylland, suggesting it handles the vast majority of the region's assessments for this specific demographic [^src1].

The clinic actively reports its clinical data to the national [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]], which monitors the quality of ADHD assessments and treatments across Denmark [^src4]. In the context of national quality standards, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn has demonstrated strong performance in several key areas. For [[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]], which measures the proportion of ADHD assessment pathways for children aged 0–5 that include a clinical environmental observation within 120 days, the clinic successfully achieves the target, reporting an 86% compliance rate (with a confidence interval of 74–94%) [^src3]. This performance is notable in a national landscape where only a few regions and departments meet the ≥90% standard for this indicator [^src1] [^src3].

For older children and adolescents, measured by [[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]] (structured diagnostic interviews or environmental observations for 6–17-year-olds within 120 days), the clinic's performance has varied across reporting periods. In the 2023/24 period, it recorded a target fulfillment of 75% (95% CI: 66–83) [^src5]. However, more recent data indicates significant improvement, with the clinic achieving a 94% fulfillment rate for Indikator 2b, placing it among the positive examples of clinical practice that consistently meet or approach the national development goal of ≥90% [^src3].

Additionally, the clinic engages in non-pharmacological interventions, recording a psychoeducation rate of 81% for [[indikator-5|Indikator 5]] [^src4]. This is significant given the systemic challenges and registration issues surrounding psychoeducation implementation nationwide [^src4]. In terms of overall volume and data validation, the clinic registered 38 disqualified (*afkræftede*) assessment pathways during the period from April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025, utilizing specific course markers to ensure accurate statistical reporting [^src6]. 

Through its consistent data contributions and high compliance rates in critical diagnostic indicators, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn serves as a central pillar in Denmark's efforts to monitor and improve early childhood ADHD diagnostics.
